findings.text: The company's status is 'dissolved', and the register records it as ceasing on 4 December 2012.
The company was incorporated on 21 April 2011 and its age at cessation is recorded as 1.6 years (593 days).
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
The company has 1 current officer, a director, PERSON 237, appointed 21 April 2011.
Accounts and the confirmation statement are of unknown overdue status, with no next due date, last made up to date, or related dates recorded.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.
No charges are registered against the company.
PERSON 237 has 3 other appointments, all of which are dissolved companies, and no registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
